visual_action: A slideshow of still photos of Republican politicians. The video starts with a photo of Donald Trump at a podium. This is followed by a photo of Ron DeSantis shouting or laughing, then Mike Pence looking stern, Nikki Haley speaking at a press conference, and finally Tim Scott speaking with his hands raised. Each photo has text overlaid describing a political position or action attributed to that person.
